_doc: The video footwork database (docs/decisions/0012-video-footwork.md). Read by unreal/footwork_setup.py, which builds PSD_Padel_Footwork with the walk loops' settings from SourceArt/_incoming/GASP/motion_matching.json and then applies database_overrides on top.

database_overrides._doc: Pose Search costs. The clips are one camera's estimate, noisier than the sample's captured loops, so footwork costs a little more to jump into (base_cost_bias > 0) and a little less to stay in (continuing_pose_cost_bias < 0): fewer clip switches. The clips are cut from rallies, not loops, so their first and last 0.3 s, whose future trajectory is cut short, are never picked (exclude_from_database_parameters, seconds; max counts back from the end). Tune against Padel.Animation.MotionMatching.

labelled_windows._doc: How mocap/wham_to_fbx.py --moves labelled cuts each labelled clip (about 5 s, mostly standing around the move) into the windows where the player moves; footwork_moves.active_windows. Moving: root ground speed over min_mps (m/s) for at least min_s, gaps up to gap_s bridged; pad_s kept either side (= the database's 0.3 s exclusion); stretches over max_s split into equal parts; windows under min_window_s dropped. Seconds. min_window_mps: per label, the median root speed (m/s) a window needs: the game shuffles at 1 to 1.5 m/s and most video shuffles near 0.7, past what the play rate stretches, so slower shuffle windows slid.

foot_plants._doc: Extra foot plants in mocap/wham_to_fbx.py (floor_mask, release_overreach): a foot at the floor is planted (held by leg IK) whatever its speed, on top of the low-and-slow contacts. WHAM's feet skim the floor faster than 0.5 m/s, and planted only when slow they glided 0.5-1.4 m/s in the game (Padel.Animation.FootworkClipSlide). Down under floor_enter_m, up over floor_exit_m (joint heights in metres; the foot joints sit 0.03 over the sole); spells under min_s dropped; a plant ends where the hip is over release_reach of the leg's length from the held ankle. Between plants, a foot that stays under floor_exit_m yet travels swing_min_travel_m or more (a step along the floor, a skate no plant can hold) is lifted on a sine arc up to swing_lift_m (lift_floor_steps).
